author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read AudioCodes Mediant SBC syslog: Activity Log lines, alarms, signaling CDRs and debug lines. The device sends syslog to the data collector, and a relay's header in front works too. Activity Log logins and logouts go to Auth, other Activity Log lines go to ManagementEvent, and raised alarms go to Thirdparty; cleared alarms, CDRs and debug lines stay generic.
notes:
Setup:
- AudioCodes Mediant SBC syslog: the device sends <PRI> and then its own fields ([S=n] [BID=...]), with no time or host name, and a relay's header in front works too.
- Turn on syslog with VoIP Debug Level at Basic (AudioCodes sends nothing while it is off) and every Activity Type to Report; CLI commands need activity-log turned on from the CLI.
- The README has the steps.

Field mapping:
- Activity Log logins, failed logins ("Unauthorized access attempt to Login Page. Reason: bad credentials") and logouts go to Auth with the user, the session's protocol and address, and the device address and port a web login was made to.
- Every other Activity Log line goes to ManagementEvent: parameter and table changes with their old and new values in the operation, CLI commands, saves and resets, with the user, address and protocol.
- Raised alarms go to Thirdparty with the alarm name as the title, its text as the summary, its severity (critical, major, minor, warning, indeterminate) and source.
- IDS alarms (acIDSPolicyAlarm, acIDSThresholdCrossNotification, acIDSBlacklistNotification) give the attacking address, and a blacklist addition is marked blocked.
- Cleared alarms, the acKeepAlive heartbeat, signaling CDRs (their columns follow the CDR Format table and the title line comes only now and then) and debug lines stay generic.

Time:
- The device's [Time:dd-mm@hh:mm:ss.mmm] has no year or zone, so the parser takes this year and reads it as UTC.

Sources and licenses:
- That the packet starts with <PRI> straight before [S=n] is seen in third-party captures, not stated by AudioCodes.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples follow the line formats in AudioCodes' Mediant 9000 manual (7.2 to 7.6), its Syslog Viewer guide and its alarm reference, with made-up values.

Testing:
- The children, each combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-22: 163 of 165 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs, and the 2 that differ are the ingest time on lines with no time of their own.
- The parent's confirm string picked the same lines there.
- As separate parsers under their parent they matched 156 of 157 fields, the one difference the same ingest time, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs.
- No built-in parser claimed these lines.
